pins.head: SPLIT THE SPACE FIRST
pins.title: Dorm Room Storage Ideas for a Shared Room: Agree on Who Gets Which Shelf
pins.desc: Dorm room storage ideas work better once roommates divide the space. Agree on ownership of closet sections, shelf positions and the space under each bed, and store unopened backups in one known location. Label ownership and contents on two visible sides, and pick a shallow container that slides out completely. The handbook and staff instructions outrank a retailer's dorm-room category. pins.head: WATCH FOR THREE DAYS
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: 15 No-Drill Ideas, Placed Where Things Already Land
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage works when it sits where the habit already happens. Observe where objects land for three days before placing storage: a basket beside the sofa is more likely to collect blankets than one across the room. The guide has 15 no-drill ideas. Photograph the surface before adding anything, keep the first test under $25 and begin with the doors, baskets and boxes you already own. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrillStorage #ApartmentLiving

pins.head: TEN ORNAMENTS, SMALL BATCH
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: 10 Resin Christmas Ornaments Made With One Easy Method
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners suits the tree this month. The guide's 10 Christmas ornament ideas include a dried-flower circle, a lightly sparkling star, a restrained mica swirl and a first-Christmas date keepsake. All of them follow one easy method: prepare the mold, measure a small batch, make a shallow pour, let it cure and then demold. Contains affiliate links. #ResinOrnaments #ChristmasOrnaments #ChristmasCrafts

pins.head: A FAN ISN'T VENTILATION
pins.sub: Set Up Before the First Pour
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: Set Up the Workstation Before You Open the Bottles
pins.desc: Epoxy resin tips usually start at mixing, but the workstation comes first. The label and Safety Data Sheet must lead the setup: record the mixing ratio, working time, cure range, ventilation guidance and required glove material. A fan that merely stirs room air is not the same as effective exhaust. Arrange supplies, measuring tools, the mixing area, the pour area and the waste container in order. Contains affiliate links. #EpoxyResin #ResinSafety #CraftRoom
pins.alt: A light wood table set up for resin work from left to right: two plain white bottles, a stack of clear plastic cups, a grey silicone mat with an empty six-cavity mold and a small lidded grey waste bin, with blue nitrile gloves and clear safety glasses in front.

pins.head: TWO MARKS, NOT ONE
pins.title: Cricut Vinyl Tips: Line Up Layered Vinyl With Two Registration Marks
pins.desc: Cricut vinyl tips for layered decals come down to reference points. Place two separated, easy-to-recognize marks outside the finished artwork, since two distant references help reveal rotation that one mark can hide. Lower each layer progressively and keep the carrier relaxed, because tension can distort spacing. Use a two-color practice design before buying a broad assortment. Contains affiliate links. #LayeredVinyl #CricutTips #VinylDecals
pins.alt: A white backing sheet on a wood table with a layered vinyl daisy decal, white petals around a black centre, and a small black-and-white square registration mark at the top left and bottom right corners, beside a piece of transfer tape and a blue felt-edged squeegee.

pins.head: EVERY BOTTLE IN VIEW
pins.title: Miniature Painting Tips: Keep Paints Upright on a Wooden Rack
pins.desc: Miniature painting tips often skip the desk itself. A wooden paint rack stands bottles up in rows so each colour shows and you can reach one without digging through a drawer. Park it at the back of the painting area, group the colours you use together and put each bottle back in the same place when a session ends. Check its size against your desk before ordering. Contains affiliate links. #MiniaturePainting #PaintStorage #HobbyDesk
